entry.title: Ukrainian Hike to Fockenstein and Geierstein
entry.summary: Joining a Ukrainian group to Fockenstein, then taking on Geierstein alone. Hike from Bad Wiessee to Lenggries via Zwergelberg (1113 m), Fockenstein (1564 m), Schlagkopf (1330 m), and Geierstein (1491 m).

entry.title: A Handful of Castles
entry.summary: Visiting cool castles and ruins between Moosburg and Landshut. Hike from Moosburg an der Isar to Landshut via Berghofen, Kronwinkl, Ast, and Tiefenbach.

entry.title: Burried in Snow at Kampen
entry.summary: Doing a cliffside climb of the Kampen ridge after heavy snowfall. Hike from Kreuth Klamm to Lenggries via Brandkopf (1569 m), Spitzkamp (1604 m), Auerkamp (1607 m), and Ochsenkamp (1594 m).

entry.title: Retrieving a Hiking Stick at Sonnenberg
entry.summary: Going back to the place I failed to take back what's mine. Hike from Unterammergau and back via Sonnenberg (1622 m).

entry.title: All Peaks from Bichl to Bad Tölz
entry.summary: Checking off all easy hikes in the area at once. Hike from Bichl to Bad Tölz via Hollerkopf (932 m), Enzenauer Kopf (1205 m), Fahrtkopf (1203 m), Angerlkopf (1249 m), Stallauer Kopf (1322 m), Stallauer Eck (1213 m), Zwiesel (1348 m), Heigelkopf (1218 m), and Blomberg (1237/1203/1248 m).

entry.title: Relaxing Spring Views at Traunsee
entry.summary: Letting Pavlo recover on a nice walk. Hike from Traunkirchen Ort to Traunkirchen via Baalstein (800 m) and Geißwand (872 m).

entry.title: First Hike Near Linz
entry.summary: Taking Pavlo for a tour near Hallstätter See. Hike from Gosau to Bad Goisern via Hoher Kalmberg (1833 m).

entry.title: Falling from Sonnenberg
entry.summary: A free fall from a cliff keeps a doctor scared and stiff. Hike from Oberammergau to Unterammergau via Zahn (1483 m) and Sonnenberg (1622 m).

entry.title: A Very Social Hike to Bolsterlanger Horn
entry.summary: Scouting out the ridges around Fischen im Allgäu. Hike from Bolsterlang and back via Bolsterlanger Horn (1586 m).

entry.title: Bridging Countries via Trainsjoch
entry.summary: Trailing the border line between Germany and Austria on a winter trip. Hike from Kiefersfelden to Bayrischzell via Trainsjoch (1707 m) and Nesselberg (1363 m).

entry.title: Snowy Setzberg
entry.summary: Plowing through the waist-deep snow to a skiing summit. Hike from Kreuth to Rottach-Egern via Setzberg (1706 m).

entry.title: First Trip to the Dolomites
entry.summary: Attempting a rocky peak at the cold of winter. Hike from Molveno and back via Palon de Tovre (1913 m) and Cima Sophia (2360 m).

entry.title: Slippery Rainerkopf
entry.summary: Going down a slippery slope with a friend. Hike from Neuhaus to Spitzingsee via Rainerkopf (1463 m).

entry.title: A Homely Hike to Jochberg
entry.summary: Joining a group of Ukrainians on a social hike. Hike from Kochelsee to Walchensee via Laimbachfall, Sonnenspitz (1259 m), and Jochberg (1565 m).

entry.title: Kufstein Christmas Market
entry.summary: Socializing on a nice relaxing hike in Austria. Hike from Kiefersfelden to Kufstein via Thierberg (721 m).

entry.title: Steep Price for a Steep Hike to Vordere Kesselschneid
entry.summary: Extending the old route to a new peak with a broken finger. Hike from Kufstein and back via Pyramidenspitze (1997 m) and Vordere Kesselschneid (2002 m).

entry.title: Bischof and Krottenkopf Trial
entry.summary: Catching the last warm days of the year and finishing off my to-do list. Hike from Farchant to Eschenlohe via Bischof (2033 m) and Krottenkopf (2086 m).

entry.title: DAAD Trip to Bodenschneid
entry.summary: A medium difficulty muddy walk to the peak and down to Bodenschneidhaus. Hike from Spitzingsee to Neuhaus via Bodenschneid (1669 m) and Rinnerspitz (1611 m).

entry.title: Tegernsee to Hausham via Auer Berg
entry.summary: Beginner-friendly route across Gindelalmschneid (1335 m) and Auer Berg (1252 m). Hike from Tegernsee to Hausham via Gindelalmschneid (1335 m), Auer Berg (1252 m), Rainer Berg (1169 m), and Huberspitz (1051 m).

entry.title: Buchstein Free Solo
entry.summary: A climb of Buchstein (1701 m) during a snowstorm starting at Bayerwald. Hike from Bayerwald to Scharling via Buchstein (1701 m).

entry.title: Mental Health Walk to Freising
entry.summary: Flat walk between two local towns. Hike from Moosburg an der Isar to Freising.

entry.title: Zugspitze via Höllental: Catch the Cable Car
entry.summary: An unlikely via ferrata climb to the top of Zugspitze before the last cable car down. Hike from Hammersbach to the Zugspitze (2962 m) peak.

entry.title: Wasserspitz and Mountain Carts
entry.summary: Going up Wasserspitz on foot. Going down Stümpfling on mountain carts. Hike from Tegernsee to Spitzingsee via Wasserspitz (1552 m) and Stümpfling (1506 m).

entry.title: Hot Pursuit of Brecherspitz
entry.summary: Hiking with a fewer has never been so fun. Hike from Spitzingsee to Neuhaus via Brecherspitz (1685 m).

entry.title: Via Ferrata Climb to Omiš Fort
entry.summary: Taking the straight way up this time. Climb from Omiš and back via Tvrđava "Stari grad" (303 m).

entry.title: Family Trip to an Old Fort
entry.summary: Taking my mom up a local mountain. Hike from Omiš and back via Tvrđava "Stari grad" (303 m).

entry.title: Returning to Höhenglücksteig
entry.summary: Getting stuck on the same via ferrata. Hike from Fischbrunn to Etzelwang via Norissteig and Höhenglücksteig.

entry.title: Exploring Höhenglücksteig
entry.summary: Trying out via ferrata climbing in the wild. Hike from Fischbrunn to Etzelwang via Norissteig and Höhenglücksteig.

entry.title: Free Solo of Breitensteinfensterl
entry.summary: Going for a real via ferrata climb with no gear. Hike from Hammer and back via Breitensteinfensterl (1350 m), Breitenstein Westgipfel (1575 m), and Breitenstein (1622 m).

entry.title: First Outdoor Via Ferrata: Brünnstein
entry.summary: Starting off with an easy route. Hike from Tatzelwurmwasserfälle to Oberaudorf via Brünnstein (1619 m).

entry.title: Forest Walk to Starnberg
entry.summary: Completing my route from Freising to Tutzing. Hike from München to Starnberg via Forstenrieder Park.

entry.title: Zugspitze Reintal Loop in a Day
entry.summary: A non-stop 22 hour hike to the top of Germany's highest mountain and back. Hike from Garmisch and back via Zugspitze (2962 m).

entry.title: TUM Hike Day 2025: Wendelstein
entry.summary: A hike I organized for the Chair for Database Systems at TUM. Hike from Osterhofen to Bayrischzell via Wendelstein (1838 m).

entry.title: Blauberge Ridge Loop
entry.summary: A summer trip along the Germany-Austria border. Hike from Wildbad Kreuth and back via Predigtstuhl (1562 m), Wichtlplatte (1765 m), Blaubergschneid (1787 m), Blaubergkopf (1787 m), Karspitz (1801 m), and Halserspitze (1863 m).

entry.title: Breitenstein and Wendelstein During Rainfall
entry.summary: Despite the rainy weather, we set out to conquer both Breitenstein and Wendelstein and finish off with some Bayrischzell cake. Hike from Hammer/Fischbachau to Bayrischzell via Breitenstein (1622 m), Türkenköpfl (1512 m), and Wendelstein (1838 m).

entry.title: First Buchstein Climb
entry.summary: My first cliff climbing experience, extended to a full day hike. Hike from Kreuth to Lenggries via Buchstein (1701 m), Roßstein (1698 m), Mariaeck (1469 m), and Seekarkreuz (1601 m).

entry.title: Laber Hauptgipfel DAAD Tour
entry.summary: Organized group hike for DAAD scholars. Hike from Oberammergau and back via Schartenkopf (1636 m) Laber Hauptgipfel (1686 m).

entry.title: Schweinsberg Easter DAAD Tour
entry.summary: Annette organized a group hike with Easter egg hunting for DAAD scholars. Hike from Geitau to Fischbachau via Türkenköpfl (1512 m) and Schweinsberg (1514 m).

entry.title: São Lourenço PR8 Intro
entry.summary: A great oceanside hike cut short by a plane ride. Hike at Vereda da Ponta de São Lourenço, partial.

entry.title: Caldeirão Verde PR9 Main Section
entry.summary: Big waterfall visit going through tunnels and smaller waterfalls on the way with the final section closed off. Hike from Parque das Queimadas to Caldeirão Verde and back.

entry.title: Pedra Rija PR1 Start
entry.summary: What was supposed to be a full-day hike turned to be a 15-minute walk due to a landslide. Hike from Pico do Areeiro to Pedra Rija and back.

entry.title: Hoher Fricken with Alcoholics
entry.summary: A goodbye hike for Mikuláš Netík, meeting German housewives downing schnapps at the top. Hike from Farchant to Garmisch-Partenkirchen via Kuhfluchtwasserfall and Hoher Fricken (1940 m).

entry.title: Frau Hitt: Push Through or Lose
entry.summary: A full-day winter hike over the famous Innsbruck ridge. Freezing cold and icy slopes mixed with frogs and goats. Hike from Scharnitz to Innsbruck via Frau Hitt (2270 m).

entry.title: Altmühltal: Riedenburg to Kelheim
entry.summary: A historical walk along river Prunn through Celtic settlements. Hike from Riedenburg to Saal through Prunn, Essing, Kloster Weltenburg, and Kelheim.

entry.title: Hochstaufen DAAD Tour
entry.summary: A DAAD tour I organized as a change of pace from the usual destinations. Hike from Piding to Bad Reichenhall via Fuderheustein (1321 m) and Hochstaufen (1771 m).

entry.title: Seekarkreuz DAAD Tour 2025
entry.summary: Annette organized a DAAD hike to the summit going down to the Hirschbachstüberl restaurant. Hike from Lenggries to Seekarkreuz (1601 m).

entry.title: Herrsching to Tutzing
entry.summary: One morning I was bored and decided to walk from one popular Bavarian lake to another. Hike from Herrsching to Tutzing via Andechs, Erling, Machtlfing, and Traubing.

entry.title: Rampoldplatte as a First
entry.summary: Testing the fitness of a new friend on a moderate winter route. Hike from Brannenburg and back via Rampoldplatte (1422 m).

entry.title: Pushing for Pyramidenspitze DAAD Tour
entry.summary: A winter rendition of the route I organized for DAAD with the group dwindling down. Hike from Kufstein and back via Petersköpfl (1745 m), Einserkogel (1924 m), Zwölferkogel (1912 m), and Pyramidenspitze (1997 m).

entry.title: Großer Traithen Ridge in Winter
entry.summary: Crossing the ridge of the highest mountain in the Rosenheim district. Hike from Bayrischzell to Oberaudorf via Großer Traithen (1852 m), Unterbergerjoch (1813 m), Steilnerjoch (1747 m).
